head_commit.message:
nanoda: larger worker stack, and start again after a stack overflow

verifier#226: the Lean kernel and the axiom audit passed, and nanoda
aborted with "thread 'thread_1' has overflowed its stack" (exit 134), so
the result was pending_review. nanoda gives each checking worker
stack_size_bytes from its config (32 MiB by default), so RUST_MIN_STACK
and ulimit -s do not change it.

- The Comparator nanoda patch reads COMPARATOR_NANODA_STACK_MIB (256,
  1024 or 4096) and writes stack_size_bytes into the nanoda config.
  inside.py sets it only from the controller's control/nanoda-stack.txt.
  The patched Comparator builds at both pins (d03acab, e3dcf30).
- Every nanoda check starts at 256 MiB. After a stack overflow it starts
  again with 1024, then 4096 MiB and the same threads, under the same
  time rule as the thread retry. Attempts record nanoda_stack_mib.
- The requeue also accepts a final receipt held only by a nanoda stack
  overflow (Lean and audit passed; the overflow read from the last
  attempt's nanoda.log), once per verifier commit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
